title: Feedback: owner notes on a task, coordinator replies, and merged lane reports

task_id.description: A task id, NEW (the board's thread of new-task requests), NEWS (the board-wide news thread: cos-report / cos-event only), or * (the whole board: a sweep).

goal_version.description: goal-lock: the goal version this lock created.

mode.description: rebrief: what the owner asked for.

auto.description: Filed by the board itself, not by the owner: a rebrief of mode status (the freshness sweep) or an idle notice (the idle detector, kind idle).

info.description: A notice of a change (the CoS route override): kept in the task stream, attributed to the actor who wrote it, but never an open feedback item — not counted, no 'mark handled'.

plan_id.description: choice: the reviewer plan the owner picked.

ask_id.description: The ask this owner answer belongs to (written by ask.answer).

choice.description: The option key of an answer.

rule.description: nudge: the supervisor rule that filed it (src/supervisor.mjs).

level.description: nudge: 1 = the owning lane, 2 = CoS, 3 = the owner.

lane.description: nudge: who must receipt it (a lane, CoS or owner).

escalated_from.description: nudge: the nudge or idle notice this one escalates.

escalated_to.description: The nudge that escalated this one (set by the supervisor).

received.description: A receipt picked this message up: at, by, receipt_id.

ask_ids.description: nudge R2: the open asks it lists.

cleared.description: nudge: the supervisor closed it: condition_cleared = its condition no longer held; superseded = a re-nudge of the same chain replaced it (src/supervisor.mjs rearmCandidates).

node_id.description: W-42 5A: the diagram node this message is anchored on. Rev 2 (M3): derived at read time from the side store (feedback.anchor line), never stored in state.json.

diagram.description: kind diagram only: the owner revision this message points at (W-42 5A contract section 4). Rev 2 (M3): derived at read time from the side line its request_id names (diagram-<diagram_id>-r<rev>), never stored in state.json.

tasks.description: cos-report / cos-event: the related tasks (each existed when written).
